title: Hey ASR System! Why Aren’t You More Inclusive? Automatic Speech Recognition Systems’ Bias and Proposed Bias Mitigation Techniques. A Literature Review.
reasoning: The paper is a literature review focused on demographic bias (race, gender, and disability) and performance parity in Automatic Speech Recognition systems.
